title: 第0021章 拳震八方谁敢称天才第0021章 拳震八方谁敢称天才
content_zh:
;;
死寂。
擂台上方的空气仿佛凝固成了实质，沉重地压在每一个人的心头。
阳光依旧明媚，却驱不散此刻弥漫在演武场上的寒意。
林啸天瘫坐在擂台边缘，锦袍沾满了灰尘和血渍，手中的精钢长剑只剩下一截寒光闪闪的断口。他满脸不敢置信，眼神空洞，仿佛灵魂都被刚才那一拳轰碎了。
他输了。
输得彻彻底底，毫无翻身之地。
一拳。
仅仅只是一拳。
他引以为傲的凡级上品修为，那把耗费了家族无数资源打造的宝剑，在林药尘那朴实无华的一拳面前，脆弱得像是一层窗户纸。
“这……这怎么可能……”
林啸天颤抖着嘴唇，声音嘶哑，像是砂纸摩擦着枯木。
他抬起头，死死盯着那个依旧负手而立的身影。
林药尘站在擂台中央，青色布袍随风轻摆，身姿挺拔如松。他并没有因为击败林啸天而露出得意之色，反而眼神更加平静，平静得让人心底发寒。
“废物。”
林药尘淡淡地吐出两个字，声音不大，却清晰地传遍了整个演武场。
这两个字，比刚才那一拳更伤人自尊。
林啸天猛地喷出一口鲜血，眼前一黑，差点晕厥过去。
台下，一片哗然。
短暂的死寂之后，是山呼海啸般的议论声。

“一拳！真的是一拳！”
“我的天，我没眼花吧？林啸天少爷竟然被一拳打飞了？”
“那个废柴林药尘……什么时候变得这么强了？”
“这哪里是废柴，这分明是扮猪吃老虎啊！”
震惊、疑惑、恐惧、兴奋……种种情绪在人群中交织蔓延。
旁系弟子们一个个激动得满脸通红，甚至有人忍不住握拳呐喊。压抑了太久，他们终于看到了翻身的机会，看到了一个属于旁系的英雄崛起。
而林家本家的那些嫡系子弟，此刻却脸色难看至极。他们原本等着看林药尘的笑话，等着看他被林啸天踩在脚下羞辱，结果等来的却是这样一个惊天逆转。
高台上，大长老林傲死死抓着座椅扶手，五指嵌入木头之中，青筋暴起，脸色铁青。
他设想过无数种可能，想过林啸天会轻松取胜，想过林药尘会负隅顽抗，甚至想过两人会两败俱伤。但他唯独没有想过，林药尘会以这种碾压的姿态，一拳击败林啸天！
“这小子……藏得太深了！”
林傲眼中闪过一丝阴毒，原本准备好的“失手击杀”剧本，此刻彻底成了笑话。如果林药尘真的只是个废柴，杀了也就杀了。但现在，林药尘展现出了惊人的战力，若是再明目张胆地下杀手，恐怕会引起旁系弟子的反弹，甚至会动摇林家的根基。
“大长老，这……”旁边的裁判长老低声问道，额头渗出了冷汗。
“比试尚未结束，慌什么！”林傲冷哼一声，强行压下心中的惊涛骇浪，目光阴鸷地盯着擂台上的林药尘。
既然明的不行，那就来暗的。
这场家族大比，绝不能让林药尘活着走出演武场！
……
擂台上。
林药尘无视了四周的喧嚣，他的目光越过昏迷的林啸天，直接落在了高台之上的大长老林傲身上。
四目相对。
林药尘的眼神清澈而坚定，带着一丝挑衅和不屈。

林傲的眼神阴冷而狠毒，带着杀意和威压。
无声的对峙，火药味弥漫。

Dead silence.
The air above the ring seemed to solidify into substance, weighing heavily on everyone's heart.
The sun was still shining brightly, but it could not dispel the chill that permeated the martial arts field at this moment.
Lin Xiaotian sat slumped on the edge of the ring, his brocade robe covered in dust and blood stains, and only a gleaming fragment of the stainless steel sword in his hand remained. His face was full of disbelief, his eyes were empty, as if his soul had been shattered by the punch just now.
He lost.
A complete loss, with no way to make a comeback.
One punch.
Just one punch.
The mortal-level cultivation that he was proud of, the sword that cost countless resources of the family to build, was as fragile as a layer of window paper in front of Lin Yaochen's simple punch.
"This...how is this possible..."
Lin Xiaotian's lips trembled and his voice was hoarse, like sandpaper rubbing against dead wood.
He raised his head and stared at the figure who was still standing with his hands behind his back.
Lin Yaochen stood in the center of the ring, his green cloth robe swaying lightly in the wind, his posture as tall as a pine tree. He did not look proud of defeating Lin Xiaotian, but his eyes became calmer, so calm that it made people feel chilled in their hearts.
"Trash."
Lin Yaochen spat out two words lightly. The sound was not loud, but it spread clearly throughout the entire martial arts arena.
These two words hurt people's self-esteem more than the punch just now.
Lin Xiaotian suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood, his vision went dark, and he almost fainted.
There was an uproar in the audience.
After a brief moment of dead silence, there was a roar of discussion like a roaring mountain and a tsunami.
"One punch! Really one punch!"
"Oh my God, am I not dazzled? Master Lin Xiaotian was actually punched away?"
"That loser Lin Yaochen...when did he become so strong?"
"How can this be useless? This is clearly pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger!"
Shock, doubt, fear, excitement...all kinds of emotions intertwined and spread among the crowd.
The side disciples all flushed with excitement, and some even couldn't help clenching their fists and shouting. After suppressing it for too long, they finally saw the opportunity to turn around and see the rise of a hero belonging to the side line.
However, the direct descendants of the Lin family looked extremely ugly at this moment. They were originally waiting to see Lin Yaochen's joke, waiting to see him trampled and humiliated by Lin Xiaotian, but what they waited for was such a shocking reversal.
On the high platform, Great Elder Lin Ao clutched the armrest of the chair tightly, his fingers embedded in the wood, his veins popped out, and his face was ashen.
He had imagined countless possibilities, thought that Lin Xiaotian would win easily, thought that Lin Yaochen would resist stubbornly, and even thought that both of them would suffer losses. But he never thought that Lin Yaochen would defeat Lin Xiaotian with one punch in such a crushing manner!
"This kid...hides it too deep!"
Lin Ao's eyes flashed with a hint of sinister intent, and the "accidental kill" script he had originally prepared turned into a complete joke. If Lin Yaochen was really just a loser, he would be killed. But now, Lin Yaochen has shown astonishing fighting power. If he continues to blatantly kill people, it may cause a backlash from the disciples of the side branches, and even shake the foundation of the Lin family.
"Great Elder, this..." the referee elder next to him asked in a low voice, cold sweat breaking out on his forehead.
"The competition is not over yet, why are you panicking!" Lin Ao snorted coldly, suppressing the turmoil in his heart, and stared at Lin Yaochen on the ring with a sinister look.
Since the bright one doesn't work, then let's do the dark one.
In this family competition, Lin Yaochen must not be allowed to walk out of the martial arts arena alive!
…
In the arena.
Lin Yaochen ignored the commotion around him. His gaze passed over the unconscious Lin Xiaotian and fell directly on the great elder Lin Ao on the high platform.
Eyes facing each other.
Lin Yaochen's eyes were clear and firm, with a hint of provocation and unyieldingness.
Lin Ao's eyes were cold and vicious, with murderous intent and pressure.
The silent confrontation was filled with the smell of gunpowder.
